g.title: Mother's Gold Spice — barni sticker (42 mm circle)
g.desc: A traditional Indian ceramic pickling jar with a cloth tied over its mouth, standing in front of the sun. The words "set in the sun" curve along the bottom of the circle.

g.title: Made in a kitchen, not a factory
g.desc: Mother's Gold Spice — round 42 mm seal sticker, typographic only.

g.title: Mother's Gold Spice — the spice roundel
g.desc: A 42 mm round die-cut sticker. A gold band carries the words FOUR THINGS above and MOTHER'S GOLD SPICE below. Inside, drawn as an old seed-packet plate, the four things themselves: a raw mango with one leaf at the top, a dried red chilli down the left, a fenugreek sprig on the right, and mustard seeds gathered at the foot.

g.title: Mother's Gold Spice — barni sticker (42 mm circle)
g.desc: A traditional Indian ceramic pickling jar with a cloth tied over its mouth, standing in front of the sun. The words "set in the sun" curve along the bottom of the circle.

g.title: Mother's Gold Spice — two badge stickers
g.desc: Two 42 by 26 mm die-cut badges side by side. Left: a rubber-stamp frame reading SMALL BATCH with the brand name beneath. Right: ONE OF THE FIRST HUNDRED JARS above a cream plaque marked No. with a ruled blank for a hand-written number.

svg.text: Mother's Gold Spice · cut along the dashed lines
